title: Viva Insights: export de-identified agent metrics from the Agent Dashboard
summary: The briefing accurately separates Microsoft's planned Copilot agent export from the documented Agent 365 export and reports the default, access requirements and rollout targets correctly. Minor corrections should preserve the documentation's data-availability qualifications and acknowledge the identification overview's alternative admin navigation.
